MOTION TO VACATE JUDGMENT FILED BY MARILYN BARTHOLOMEW IS GRANTED. CONTINUED TO JAN-30-2019 AT 3:30 PM IN 506 FOR TRIAL.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-30-2019 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO AUG-07-2019 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF GOLDEN GATE TOW, INC IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY FRANCISCO GUZMAN. DEFENDANT MARILYN BARTHOLOMEW IS PRESENT. MOTION TO VACATE DEFAULT JUDGMENT IS GRANTED. JUDGMENT FOR $3,150.00 PLUS INTEREST AND COSTS ENTERED ON DECEMBER 11, 2018 IS VACATED. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT TO CONTINUE WITH SETTLEMENT OF APRIL 30, 2018 ACCORDING TO THE FOLLOWING TERMS: PLAINTIFF TO PAY $50.00 ON OR BEFORE THE FOLLOWING DATES: 2/15, 3/15, 4/15, 5/15, 6/15, AND FINAL PAYMENT OF $2900 DUE ON 7/15/2019. OTHER TERMS OF AGREEMENT OF APRIL 30, 2018 REMAIN IN EFFECT, INCLUDING 4) IF DEFENDANT BARTHOLOMEW FAILS TO MAKE ANY PAYMENT WHEN DUE, PLAINTIFF MUST PROVIDE NOTICE OF DEFAULT AND OPPORTUNITY TO CURE TO DEFENDANT BY EMAIL. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE AUG-7-2019 IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE. IF NO APPEARANCE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
